research_mode: official UK government and ONS primary statistical publications and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: CJS bulletin scope
verified_claims: The bulletin covers out-of-court resolutions, prosecutions, convictions, remand and sentencing in England and Wales.
limitations: It does not measure all crime experienced by the public.

sources.name: Latest-year period
verified_claims: The latest year covers January to December 2025.
limitations: Calendar-year justice data should not be merged silently with financial-year police data.

sources.name: Accredited status
verified_claims: Criminal Justice Statistics Quarterly is an accredited official-statistics series.
limitations: Accreditation does not remove revisions or administrative-data limitations.

sources.name: Individuals formally dealt with
verified_claims: About 1.59 million individuals were formally dealt with by the CJS in the latest year.
limitations: The total is not a count of offences or unique lifetime offenders.

sources.name: Formal-dealings change
verified_claims: The number formally dealt with increased by 3% in the latest year.
limitations: Changes can reflect court throughput and enforcement activity.

sources.name: Out-of-court resolutions
verified_claims: Out-of-court resolutions increased from about 212,000 to 226,300.
limitations: Different resolution types have different eligibility and recording rules.

sources.name: Community resolutions
verified_claims: Community resolutions increased from about 163,700 to 181,700.
limitations: A community resolution is not equivalent to a conviction.

sources.name: Prosecution change
verified_claims: Prosecutions increased by 3% in the latest year.
limitations: Prosecution counts can be influenced by case backlogs and charging decisions.

sources.name: Conviction change
verified_claims: Convictions increased by 1% in the latest year.
limitations: Conviction growth should not be treated as a direct measure of crime prevalence.

sources.name: Indictable prosecution change
verified_claims: Indictable-offence prosecutions increased by 9%.
limitations: Offence mix and court throughput affect the change.

sources.name: Indictable prosecution series high
verified_claims: Indictable prosecutions reached their highest level since 2016.
limitations: A series high is period-specific and not a parcel-level safety result.

sources.name: Magistrates' custody-remand count
verified_claims: About 67,000 defendants were remanded in custody at magistrates' courts.
limitations: Defendants on remand have not necessarily been convicted.

sources.name: Custody-remand proportion
verified_claims: The magistrates' court custody-remand proportion remained about 5%.
limitations: A stable proportion can coexist with a higher count because caseload changes.

sources.name: Indictable custody-rate trend
verified_claims: The custody rate for indictable offences remained stable and above the level a decade earlier.
limitations: The rate depends on offence and offender mix.

sources.name: Average custodial sentence trend
verified_claims: The overall average custodial sentence length fell slightly.
limitations: An overall average can change because the composition of sentenced offences changes.

sources.name: Theft case-mix effect
verified_claims: A higher share of theft offences, which often receive shorter sentences, contributed to the average-sentence reduction.
limitations: This is a compositional explanation, not proof about any individual sentence.

sources.name: Motoring prosecution trend
verified_claims: Motoring offence prosecutions reached a ten-year high.
limitations: Motoring regulatory cases should not be combined with violent-crime indicators.

sources.name: Indictable offence contributors
verified_claims: The bulletin notes notable prosecution increases for sexual and public-order offences.
limitations: Recorded justice-system changes may reflect reporting, charging and throughput.

sources.name: June 2026 data improvement
verified_claims: The page was updated on 29 June 2026 for a compensation-data improvement in associated tools.
limitations: Users should use the current version rather than an earlier extract.

sources.name: Parcel-attribution boundary
verified_claims: CJS totals describe justice-system activity and contain no exact property attribution.
limitations: No parcel score or candidate value should be produced from national disposal totals.
